title: Skills & agent roles
summary: Package repeatable procedures around real tasks and executable supporting tools.

sections.label: Starting package
sections.text: Choose procedures that repeat in the actual work, such as requirements investigation, impact analysis, verification or review preparation. Add specialized skills only when their tasks are present.

sections.label: Author from evidence
sections.text: Create a skill when a useful procedure repeats or an observed failure reveals missing guidance. A large persona catalog does not substitute for working tools and acceptance criteria.

sections.label: Specialized examples
sections.text: Jenkins diagnosis, RDF/SPARQL verification and country-source review illustrate particular environments. They are not a required starter package.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
